description: Version 1.0.1 of a foundational preprint proposing Boundary-State Calculus as a typed audit calculus for claims that move between scientific descriptions. The associated repository supplies editable source, a two-page synopsis, claim and notation ledgers, a revision memorandum, eight exact mathematical fixtures, and one deterministic execution receipt. It is not a fundamental ontology, a unified physical theory, a complete reference implementation, or a peer-reviewed result.
title: On Boundaries of Evidence — Boundary-State Calculus for Typed Observation, Admissible Transfer, and Falsifiable Persistence
